primary_keyword: trial to paid conversion rate benchmarks

facts.claim: Free-trial products convert on a different distribution entirely: only 7% fall below 2.5%, and the most common band is 7.5% to 10%
facts.source_title: What is a good free-to-paid conversion rate?
facts.excerpt: Only 7% of free-trial products see conversion below 2.5%; about a quarter see between 7.5% and 10%, the most common bucket.

facts.claim: Across a survey of more than 1,000 products, a fifth of freemium products convert below 2.5% and the largest group, a third, sits between 2.5% and 5%
facts.source_title: What is a good free-to-paid conversion rate?
facts.excerpt: A fifth (20%) of products see a conversion rate below 2.5%. About a third see between 2.5% and 5% — the biggest bucket.

facts.claim: Across more than 17,000 apps, trial conversion rises with length: 25.5% under four days, 37.4% at five to nine days, 35.4% at ten to sixteen and 42.5% at seventeen to thirty-two
facts.source_title: How long should your free trial be? Data from 17,000+ apps
facts.excerpt: Under 4 days: 25.5%; 5 to 9 days: 37.4%; 10 to 16 days: 35.4%; 17 to 32 days: 42.5%.

facts.claim: Trials of seventeen to thirty-two days convert about 70% better than trials under four days
facts.source_title: How long should your free trial be? Data from 17,000+ apps
facts.excerpt: Trials in the 17-to-32-day range convert about 70% better than trials under 4 days.

facts.claim: 46.5% of apps now use a trial of four days or shorter, up from 42.1% a year earlier, because paid acquisition needs a fast conversion signal
facts.source_title: How long should your free trial be? Data from 17,000+ apps
facts.excerpt: 46.5% of apps now use trials of 4 days or shorter, up from 42.1% a year earlier; paid acquisition needs a fast conversion signal.

facts.claim: 84% of three-day trial cancellations happen between day 0 and day 1, against 64% of seven-day trial cancellations
facts.source_title: How long should your free trial be? Data from 17,000+ apps
facts.excerpt: 84% of 3-day trial cancellations occur between day 0 and day 1, while 64% of 7-day trial cancellations happen in that period.

facts.claim: 95% of annual app subscribers who cancel never come back
facts.source_title: 95% of annual app subscribers who cancel never return, RevenueCat finds
facts.excerpt: 95% of annual app subscribers who cancel never return, RevenueCat finds.
